basics.name: Manas Patel
basics.label: Senior Frontend Engineer & UI Platform Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Frontend & UI Platform Engineer with 8+ years of experience architecting high-scale enterprise SPAs and micro-frontend platforms. Proven track record across tier-1 product and fintech companies (Atlassian, Apollo.io, Coinbase, Walmart Labs, Cisco) leading core developer experience (DX) initiatives, optimizing complex Webpack/SWC build pipelines, and shipping enterprise-grade web applications. Deep expertise in React, TypeScript, state management, web performance optimization, and distributed frontend platforms.
basics.headline: Senior Frontend Engineer @ Atlassian | Ex-Apollo.io, Coinbase, Walmart, Cisco | Web Performance, UI Platforms & Micro-Frontends

work.name: Atlassian
work.summary: Core Cloud Platform & Enterprise UI Engineering
highlights: Architecting critical frontend modules and shared platform components powering high-traffic enterprise workflows across Jira and Confluence ecosystems.
Spearheading performance optimization audits targeting Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS), improving page responsiveness across distributed pods.
Collaborating with product designers and backend architects on cross-cutting feature roadmaps and frontend system RFCs.

work.name: Apollo.io
highlights: Implemented custom Webpack and SWC configurations resulting in a 20% reduction in local and CI build times.
Streamlined GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, cutting deployment turnaround by 30% and accelerating release cycles across product pods.
Reduced JavaScript bundle sizes by 25% through advanced tree-shaking, code-splitting, and dynamic imports, boosting runtime performance and retention.
Led organization-wide migration from React 16.x to 17.x/18.x, unblocking modern ecosystem libraries and significantly enhancing DX.
Engineered end-to-end automated testing infrastructure from scratch using Cypress, establishing standard testing practices.

work.name: Coinbase
work.position: Senior Software Engineer / Senior Frontend Engineer
work.summary: Internal Tools / Automation & Machine Learning Platforms
highlights: Spearheaded technical design and UI architecture of 'Bot Maker', a visual workflow automation platform that saved an estimated ~$10M annually in operational overhead.
Architected and delivered internal web applications enabling Machine Learning and Data Science engineers to monitor and deploy production ML models, eliminating redundant manual workflows.
Architected an AWS-backed graph database proof-of-concept (POC) to index and centralize enterprise-wide blockchain data pipelines for internal querying.

work.name: Walmart Global Tech India
highlights: Designed and implemented a Backend-For-Frontend (BFF) architecture using React.js, Node.js, and GraphQL to harmonize API contracts across web and mobile surfaces, reducing configuration bugs by 50%.
Scaled ASDA.com's retail media advertising engine by executing complex ad placements with product managers, contributing to a ~20% increase in ad revenue.
Engineered accessible, high-performance UI components conforming to strict e-commerce conversion and uptime SLAs.

work.name: Cisco Systems India Pvt. Ltd.
highlights: Delivered reusable UI plugins and widgets for Cisco DNA-C, a plugin-based micro-frontend architecture consumed by cross-functional engineering teams.
Architected an interactive device tree visualization system utilizing React, HTML5 Canvas, and GoJS for complex network topology management.
Boosted page load speeds by 30% through lazy loading, React PureComponents/memoization, asset bundling, and image sprite optimization.
Maintained high code quality and test coverage using TDD practices and SonarQube quality gates, systematically reducing technical debt.

work.name: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS)
highlights: Engineered enterprise UI screens supporting complex, real-time editable data grids with Excel-like functionality.
Implemented centralized state management architectures using Angular and NgRx for data-intensive client applications.
Created reusable UI components and helper utilities in TypeScript/ES6 to enforce design consistency across modules.
Promoted from Assistant System Engineer (2016–2018) to System Engineer (2018–2019) based on delivery excellence.

certificates.name: Programming in HTML5 with JavaScript and CSS3
